commentary.headline: Revenue increased 11.9% YoY
commentary.detail: Revenue changed by EUR 3.3m and EBIT by EUR 0.9m versus 2025-08.

commentary.headline: Hardware is the largest EBIT contributor
commentary.detail: Hardware generated EUR 1.9m EBIT in the month; Software is the lowest contributor at EUR 1.4m.

commentary.headline: Net working capital is EUR 51.3m
commentary.detail: DSO 47 days, DIO 57 days and DPO 44 days.

commentary.headline: Free cash flow is EUR 9.0m
commentary.detail: Cash generation is derived from customer collections, supplier payments, tax, interest and CAPEX rather than from a standalone cash assumption.

commentary.headline: Base forecast covers 12 forward months
commentary.detail: The current vintage is 2026-08 and includes explicit Upside and Downside scenarios plus historical bias correction.
